ark0: When your hamstring muscles are strong enough. Returning too early can make the injury worse, while staying inactive for too long can lead to muscle wasting and scar tissue. Deciding when to return together with a physiotherapist or doctor is the safest approach. According to a 2023 international expert consensus, pain is the most important guide to progressing rehabilitation; you should be able to sprint without pain and complete full, unrestricted training sessions before returning to sport.
